verdict.rationale: The only evidence near bulk operations is kongctl's declarative mode, which manages resources as code and so implies applying many entities at once (docs-41, probe-4), plus a conversion extension for migrating an existing configuration (docs-25) and a list endpoint (docs-14). No bulk endpoint or explicit batch create, update, or delete is documented. Missing for 10: explicit bulk or batch API operations, documented multi-item update/delete semantics, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
